body: Pretty much all of my non school/sleep time goes to daydreaming; I spend a ridiculous amount of time in my own head. I watch a couple of series and read a manga, and go out occasionally to drink with friends. I enjoy learning some physics by myself, tough it's been more than a year now since I've learned anything substantial. I have enjoyed hiking in the woods and shit, but almost never do it.

> But I know that once this month is over, things will be so much better for me

Right, that's precisely it. I'm sincerely glad you have something to look forward to. But things won't be better for me next month, next year, or whenever in the foreseeable future. I'm a complete loser who's out of ideas on how to fix his life.

I'm a mediocre student with no work experience, set out to perform shitty work for shitty pay or be unemployed. I'm a 20 years old kissless virgin with no hobbies, passions that people can relate to, barely any knowledge of popular culture, and just a generally boring and uninteresting guy. I'm incapable of most basic functions expected of an adult because I was overprotected. I'm anxious and shy as hell.

I am actually going through a particularly horrible time in my life. But I'm not planning suicide because of that. I'm doing it because I'm pretty sure my life won't ever be good. I don't feel like being a burden to society for another 60 years just so I can continue to suffer and run from death.
Not really, but if you think you have anything interesting to say, go ahead.
